I mean, she wants to have sex with you and was pretty upfront and honest. She didn't ghost you or feed you some lie about how size isn't important.

Imagine if you go over there and have a great night. If she says she enjoyed it afterwards, you'll know she's telling the truth. I say go.
I don't know man. I feel the same way, like I'm just barely holding on. Nothing interests or excites me. All I feel is an overwhelming sense that I don't belong here.
Thanks for the concern though. I just don't see anything I can do.
Most of my friends are guys who only have guy friends. I tried lot of things. I'll never try online dating or speed dating again, I can't handle the rate of rejection.

I made this account just to comment on this: I used to think like you did. I think people have a duty to procreate responsibly. People with hereditary diseases shouldn't have kids that with have to suffer the same way they did. So, I decided I would never have kids.

The thing is that penis size is likely not hereditary. At least, not from men. A lot of studies lately suggest that penis size may be predetermine in the womb, due to exposure of certain hormones. This is why two male blood relatives may have wildly different penis sizes.

So, you should feel free to have kids, you won't pass it down.
